mcqs.question: Who among the following was included in TIME Women of the Year 2026 for founding Educate Girls?
mcqs.explanation: Safina Hussain, founder of Educate Girls, was included in TIME Women of the Year 2026. Reshma Kewalramani, Reshma Saujani and Chloé Zhao were among the other honourees, not the founder of Educate Girls.
